requests.name: 寒冰剑
requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Fresh game equipment card art for 寒冰剑.
DESIGN: ONE long cold-forged sword diagonal lower-left hilt to upper-right tip. Plain charcoal grip and thick ice-blue guard. Blade in a few long milky blue/ivory planes, one cobalt icy seam, slightly uneven frozen edge. THREE broad flat shard marks beside blade indicate freezing, no detailed snow crystals or snowflake diagram. Full tip/hilt inside frame. Background SOLID deep slate-blue and pale icy-gray diagonal blocks, localized cyan blade edge. Strong sharp large silhouette, matte opaque symbolic ice.
STYLE: ROUGH HAND-PAINTED ANIME GAME-PROP COLOR STUDY. Large opaque blunt swipes build entire planes; one base mass, ONE connected shadow and 2–3 broad uneven midtone marks per region, plenty of quiet interiors. Confident imperfect handmade edges, a few loose structural lines and broken stroke endings. Believable basic object volume but deliberately unfinished, no polished product render. Muted colored grays and 1–2 localized identity colors, grouped hard-edge matte values. Fewer WIDER purposeful strokes, not grain/canvas filters, fine scratches, tiny chips, facet mosaics or noise. No photoreal materials, glossy 3D, elaborate engraving, dense decoration, many glints, airbrush gradients, bloom or particles. BACKGROUND ONLY pure large flat SOLID color fields, no actual room/ground/landscape/sky. ONE symbolic object as the main subject, no person/hands/face. LANDSCAPE 4:3 opaque full canvas, roughly 75% object coverage with breathing room. Inputs1/2 provide paint grammar ONLY, never copy their people/outfits/props/backdrops. No card frame, typography, numerals, writing, logos, watermark or UI.
